[RLOW.17.2] **Construction and matching lower differently.** A constructed
fact — `TestFact`, `TestReply`, `TestCacheSeed` — carries **literal** slot
values, every author-supplied slot given. An `Oracle*` atom carries a **partial
match**: inline slot-equality constraints or, on `OracleEmit` and
`OraclePublish`, a `where` predicate in their place, flagged by `has_where` and
realized as a compiler-synthesised internal rule ([LTSL.8.4]).

The split mirrors the author surface ([LTSL.4]) rather than inventing one: what
an author builds is total, what an author asserts about is partial.
